<div class="card-body">
'''Captain Piett''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ピエット艦長</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダーと同じ位置にいるなら戦闘力＋１。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２（艦が「エグゼクター」なら３）を加える。１フォース消費して自分のリザーブデッキからプローブ・ドロイドを探し出し、手札に入れることができる。その後リザーブデッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの所に置く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Captain-Piett-PSA-145551186.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">エグゼクターの艦長。遠隔域に放ったプローブ・ドロイドの動向を追跡監視している。数々の逮捕や鎮圧活動を行い、矢継ぎ早に昇進を重ねてきた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Captain Piett.

'''Card text:'''
Power +1 when at the same location as Vader. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots (3 if the ship is Executor). May use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for a Probe Droid and take it into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.

'''Lore:'''
Captain of the Executor. He tracks probe droids sent into remote regions. A string of arrests and suppressions has brought him rapid promotion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese is power +1 at the same location as Vader; the English at the same site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Captain Piett]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
